tex_content.label: thmI.10.1
tex_content.html: For every $\alpha >0$ there are $\delta ,\epsilon >0$ such that a complete pointed flow on $[0,(\epsilon r_0)^2]$ with $R(x,0)\ge -r_0^{-2}$ and \begin{equation} \vol (\partial \Omega )^n\ge (1-\delta )c_n\vol (\Omega )^{n-1} \end{equation} for $x\in B_0(x_0,r_0)$ and $\Omega \subset B_0(x_0,r_0)$ satisfies \begin{equation} |\Rm |(x,t)<\alpha t^{-1}+(\epsilon r_0)^{-2} \end{equation} whenever $0<t\le (\epsilon r_0)^2$ and $d_t(x,x_0)\le \epsilon r_0$.
